comment: The ingestion speed of the enterprise data platform has reduced our overnight batch times by over 60%. Absolutely critical for morning reporting.
RAG search results are accurate, but the API documentation for custom webhook integrations could be improved with more Python examples.
The grounded citation feature gives our compliance team complete confidence in the generative summaries. No hallucinations observed.
Experienced an incident during the regional cutover and took 4 hours to get an engineer on call. Resolution was solid once reached.
SOC-2 compliance and RBAC access controls passed our internal audit with zero flags. Onboarding took less than a week.
